scope: Pinned source resources, original RMF Obelix physical model, and native Fortress sensor conversion; runtime evidence is stored separately.

imu_reference.verification: Read from the same pinned commit; downloaded blobs checked against Git blob identifiers.

lidar_simulator.selection: Dependency branch declared by upstream packages_https.rosinstall, resolved and pinned independently; no historical same-date claim.

hector_gazebo_imu_reference.selection: Chosen public implementation reference. The original RMF/lidar dependency does not pin or declare a Hector version; this is not a claim about the historical runtime version.
hector_gazebo_imu_reference.cross_check: Both files are byte-identical at kinetic-devel commit c60323a5e0484db9f5447bfcb1554c5b2468a65b.

fortress_imu_reference.selection: Release tags match the installed Fortress sensors 6.9.0 and simulator 6.18.0.

tools.xacro: official ros-humble-xacro 2.1.1-1jammy.20260307.132851, installed in existing development container (37.8 kB archive; no other package changed)
tools.sdformat: Fortress ign sdf; final generated model passes ign sdf -k

source_physics.rotor_configuration_note: Combined inertia is at zero rotor joint angles; the four physical rotors remain separate moving bodies.

native_model.rotors: Four original physical moving links/joints, axes +Z; 0 front-right ccw, 1 back-left ccw, 2 front-left cw, 3 back-right cw.
native_model.initialization: No commanded or initialized rotor speed; native gravity and motor plugins govern motion.
native_model.contact_publication: Fortress Contact.cc reads sensor/contact/topic; each body/rotor contact sensor sets that nested topic. A sensor-level topic alone does not enable contact publication. This adapter setting leaves original collision geometry and physical parameters unchanged.

conversion: Only stale gpu/organize_cloud xacro arguments are omitted from the temporary call site.
Zero-range sensor joints become fixed rigid mounts; their original masses and inertias are lumped by sdformat.
Original link/rotor geometry, inertias, motor constants and slowdown are retained.
Classic lidar gaussianNoise is represented by native Gaussian range noise; exact point layout/noise parity is not claimed.

sensor.name: OS0-128 source macro configured for 64 beams

physical_source_notes: The upstream OS0 macro sets mass to 1e-9 kg but inertia to diag(0.000241148,0.000241148,0.000264) kg m^2; these unusual values are retained, not silently corrected.
The upstream rotor inertia macro uses mass_rotor multiplied by rotor_velocity_slowdown_sim=10; its inertia is retained while each rotor mass remains 0.003 kg.
Source mass/inertia and controller YAML values differ. The source .5265 kg/.01 kg m^2 controller parameters are retained unchanged; no gain or model tuning is hidden in the generator.
The actual source lidar sensor pose is z=.08 m; the ROS1 launch z=.05 m static TF is stale and is not copied.
No external force, kinematic pose overwrite, preset hover rotor speed or world-fixed joint is introduced.
not_migrated: Classic ROS interface, telemetry and logging plugins; ROS2 bridges are configured by launch.
licensing: Original source headers and package.xml license metadata are retained. lidar_simulator LICENSE is copied unchanged. The IMU adapter retains RotorS Apache-2.0 attribution and Hector BSD-3-Clause notice.

validation.kind: Original offline xacro/SDF checks plus subsequent native mission runtime evidence
validation.runtime_simulation: results/fortress_rmf/mission4.json; one-start automatic takeoff/exploration/return/contact-confirmed landing/stopped rotors passed; original static resource checks remain unchanged.
validation.runtime_scope: ARM64 Fortress/Humble; native model, Lee control, motors, lidar and IMUs used. No ROS1 whole-system or Linux x86 equivalence claim; controller-generated takeoff profile was not ValidatePath-certified.

imu.measurement_pipeline: Three noise-free native Fortress type=imu sensors at the original mounts -> ros_gz_bridge sensor_msgs/Imu -> rmf_imu_adapter_node -> original logical IMU outputs.
imu.model_system: ignition-gazebo-imu-system (ignition::gazebo::systems::Imu), attached once to this model.
imu.orientation_reference: World/map axes: CUSTOM localization with custom_rpy=0 0 0 and parent_frame=world; orientation is independent of initial spawn yaw.
imu.sample_source: Native sensor acceleration, angular velocity and orientation. Adapter subscribes only to raw IMU topics; no odometry/pose input or sample interpolation.

rotors_stochastic_model.initial_state: Zero dynamic bias; independent fixed turn-on bias drawn once for gyro and acceleration axes.
rotors_stochastic_model.covariance: Gyro and acceleration diagonals are continuous noise density squared, as in RotorS, not total measurement uncertainty. All nine orientation covariance entries are -1; orientation carries the native world-referenced quaternion.
rotors_stochastic_model.parameter_name_compatibility: The original xacro emits gyroscopeRandomWalk but the pinned plugin reads gyroscopeBiasRandomWalk. Both ADIS and nominal ground_truth therefore use the header default 2*4/3600/180*pi. The ground_truth gyro random walk remains nonzero.
rotors_stochastic_model.rate: Original RotorS updates every physics step. Native rate 500 Hz matches the current max_step_size=0.002 s world.

hector_stochastic_model.initial_state: Each acceleration/rate bias drawn from N(0,drift^2); offset=0, scale=1.
hector_stochastic_model.output: native_measurement * scale_error + offset + updated_dynamic_drift + gaussian_noise * N(0,1)
hector_stochastic_model.orientation: Reference pseudo-AHRS: rotate acceleration bias to world coordinates; normalize quaternion error [1, 0.5*b_world_y/g, -0.5*b_world_x/g, 0], compose with yaw bias and native orientation. Bias only; no gyro-bias integration or white-noise orientation injection.
hector_stochastic_model.covariance: Acceleration/rate covariance retain startup GaussianNoise squared; orientation covariance follows current GaussianNoise, as in the source plugin.
hector_stochastic_model.parameter_name_compatibility: OS0 macro emits headingDrift/headingGaussianNoise=.005. The selected Hector reference reads yaw-prefixed parameters, so effective yaw drift/noise are zero.

imu.native_noise_decision: Fortress GaussianNoiseModel decays the initial and dynamic bias together, unlike the fixed RotorS turn-on bias. Hector uses a different dt-scaled driving term and bias-coupled attitude. Native noise is disabled; the adapter applies each source model once.
timing_and_randomness: First accepted sample uses its nominal sensor period; subsequent updates use acquisition stamp differences.
Duplicate, nonpositive, nonfinite or reversed samples are rejected before random state advances. Gaps greater than 1.5 nominal periods are counted; missing samples are not fabricated.
Each stream has a separate default_random_engine seeded by random_seed=1. RotorS axis draw order is retained; bit-for-bit cross-library or cross-sensor random-sequence equivalence is not claimed.
Clock reversal rejects samples until timestamps catch up. Restart the adapter after resetting simulation time.
native_measurement_differences: Native physics IMU measurements replace Classic link acceleration and Hector finite differences of velocity and quaternion.
Hector reference starts with dt=0 and zero ideal acceleration. The adapter retains the first native measurement and uses its nominal period instead of reproducing this initialization artifact.
imu.diagnostics: Trigger service /rmf/imu_state reports native source stamp, received/published/rejected counts and acquisition interval gaps for each stream.

static_validation.runtime: Subsequent runtime evidence is recorded in imu.runtime_validation; this does not change the original static provenance.

runtime_validation.scope: Offline source/measurement review of the existing native mission; no second simulation.
observations: All six streams finite with positive monotonic acquisition stamps and expected frames.
World-reference native orientation, body angular velocity and sensor-offset specific force agree with recorded changing tilt/yaw; native specific force is R^T(a-g).

Retained exact-stamp differences and covariance arrays agree with source-effective noise contracts; ground_truth acceleration unchanged while its gyro keeps the source-default nonzero bias random walk.
Raw gyro versus native pose derivative RMS about .0006 rad/s; raw sensor-position specific-force RMS .003677/.003519/.006201 m/s^2 for ADIS/ground_truth/OS0 with +/-20 ms differences.
limitations: First/every-tenth per stream/phase histories cap at 1000; the two 500 Hz raw flight histories end about 27.59 s and exact flight input/output pairs end at 12.208 s before significant rotation. Rotation checks use each individual stream; OS0 exact pairs cover rotation.
Full-run maximum acceleration 1187.502 m/s^2 is retained in summaries but absent from sampled histories; exact impulse time cannot be recovered. No clipping or replacement.
One zero-spawn-yaw native mission; no noise distribution, Allan variance, all-axis hardware or full ROS1 statistical equivalence validation. Source covariance is not total uncertainty.

services.calibrate: std_srvs/Empty: reset only gyro dynamic bias to zero

hector_runtime_interfaces.bias_topic: output_topic + /bias: sensor_msgs/Imu, same header, current dynamic drift + fixed offset for accel/rate, actual orientationError, zero covariance
hector_runtime_interfaces.preserved: No service-generated sample, timestamp reset, RNG draw or changes to drift/noise parameters
hector_runtime_interfaces.finite_request_adaptation: Nonfinite vectors are ignored and counted; original empty response has no success field
hector_runtime_interfaces.remaining: ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure wire protocol/UI is replaced by native ROS2 parameters; original RNG implementation/library bit parity is not claimed.

hector_dynamic_parameters.implementation: Native ROS 2 parameter services on gbplanner_rmf_imu_adapter; os0 and enabled smb_os1 streams
hector_dynamic_parameters.types: accel/rate: three doubles; yaw: one double
hector_dynamic_parameters.startup: Preserves loaded per-axis values and 1/3600 default frequency; cfg GUI defaults do not overwrite source model defaults
hector_dynamic_parameters.native_parameter_adaptation: Only named arrays/scalars change. Unlike ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure, an update does not broadcast all five scalar GUI values over all three axes. ROS1 wire protocol/UI are not emulated.
hector_dynamic_parameters.atomicity: Validate complete Hector-only batch before applying. Reject mixed non-Hector batches; static node parameters are read-only. Pure use_sim_time retains rclcpp behavior.
hector_dynamic_parameters.state: No RNG consumption, drift reset, time reset or synthetic sample on configuration. Offset contributes to total published bias and pseudo-AHRS. SetBias changes dynamic drift only; rate calibration preserves fixed offset.
hector_dynamic_parameters.measurement: native_measurement * scale_error + offset + updated_dynamic_drift + gaussian_noise * N(0,1)
hector_dynamic_parameters.yaw: ScaleError remains unused, matching source yawModel.update(dt); yaw white noise affects covariance but not pseudo-AHRS bias quaternion.
hector_dynamic_parameters.covariance: Acceleration/rate covariance retain startup GaussianNoise squared; orientation covariance follows current GaussianNoise, as in the source plugin.
hector_dynamic_parameters.scope: Each native stream contributes 30 same-stamp raw/output/bias samples after a runtime update, plus paused state transitions. No noise-distribution, motion or complete-migration claim.
